description: Stdlib taint models (extracted from root rule pack)

rules.title: Command execution with tainted data
rules.suggestion: Pass argument lists to subprocess with shell=False and validate user-controlled command components.

rules.title: Dynamic code execution with tainted data
rules.suggestion: Avoid dynamic code execution; use explicit dispatch tables or parsers for user-controlled expressions.

rules.title: Unsafe deserialization with tainted data
rules.suggestion: Use safe data formats or safe loaders, and avoid deserializing untrusted bytes.

rules.title: Logging tainted data
rules.suggestion: Normalize or encode untrusted text before writing it to logs.

rules.title: HTML and URL encoding sanitizer
rules.suggestion: Use context-specific encoding for the output context.

rules.title: Path component sanitizer
rules.suggestion: Validate normalized paths against an allowed base directory.
